title: Meesho sees near-term margin pressure as it reinvests in growth
summary: Meesho sees near-term margin pressure as it reinvests in growth
detailed: The value commerce platform’s September quarter results on Wednesday showed its contribution margin rising to 6% of net merchandise value (NMV) in the second quarter of FY27 from 4.6% in the April-June period. Contribution margin is the income after deducting direct, order-linked expenses.
